name: cadentor-service-4
description: Cadentor Service 4 — Dormant Lead & Database Reactivation Engine

scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w @cadentor/shared && npm run db:generate
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @cadentor/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @cadentor/shared" "npm run dev -w @cadentor/api" "npm run dev -w @cadentor/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cadentor/shared && npm run build -w @cadentor/api && npm run build -w @cadentor/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @cadentor/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @cadentor/shared && tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
